head: QuickStar on One UI 9.5: one picture across your whole Quick Panel
dek: Samsung's QuickStar module in Good Lock now has a Set all option on One UI 9.5 that stretches one picture across the Quick Panel buttons. Until now, each button could only get its own background.
details: You can pinch to zoom, drag the picture and choose which rows of buttons it covers. It works with QuickStar 12.0.02.28 and isn't there on One UI 9 or older. The same update adds grid tile settings and renames Ongoing Chip to Ongoing activities. Samsung's changelog didn't mention the new option.
where: Galaxy phones on One UI 9.5, through Good Lock's QuickStar module
means: If your Galaxy phone runs One UI 9.5, you can theme the whole Quick Panel with one photo instead of setting each button.
todo: Open Good Lock, go to QuickStar and tap Edit panel style. On the Panel button layout screen tap Set all, pick a picture, adjust it and tap Apply. If the preview is empty, open the Quick Panel once, go back and tap Sync.
